notes.title: NBA 2K25's New Gen version is coming to PC!
notes.content:
Stack wins, raise banners, and make history in NBA 2K25.

The New Gen version of [i]NBA 2K25[/i] is now supported on PC. Powered by enhanced ProPLAY™ technology, New Gen [i]NBA 2K25[/i] delivers the franchise’s most true-to-life basketball experience yet, offering players the ultimate control in how they dominate the competition. Players on PC with compatible specs will now benefit from the enhanced realism of ProPLAY™ technology, and the ability to compete in modes such as MyNBA, The W and in The City.

Pre-Purchase NBA 2K25 Now: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2878980/NBA_2K25/]NBA 2K25 on Steam[/url]

notes.title: KICKSTART YOUR NBA 2K24 SEASON
notes.content:
All players who install NBA 2K24, and login by Sept 30, 2023 will earn 10,000 VC, 6x 10 Game Skill Boosts, a MyTEAM Ruby Option Pack, and 2x 1-Hour Double XP Coins (1x MyCAREER, 1x MyTEAM)

But that's not all! You'll also receive seasonal rewards (including 10,000 VC) at the beginning of both Season 2 and Season 3.

Already purchased? We got you, this reward still applies!

notes.title: NBA 2K24 codes March 2024 - all locker codes
notes.content:
March 13, 2024: Checked for new and expired codes.

What are the active NBA 2k24 codes? Every new game in the 2K sports series has a selection of freebies given away, and the latest in 2K's basketball games is no exception. There are plenty of NBA 2K24 locker codes to redeem for new player cards, XP boosts, and MyPlayer gear, among others. However, you'll need to be quick to snag them for yourself.

This is because many of the early NBA 2k24 codes are exclusive to relatively small thresholds of players. Some freebies in this series of sports games come and go like whispers in the wind, so you need to act fast. However, we're now starting to get some freebies that are sticking around for longer, so we've gathered these NBA 2k24 locker codes to give you a little boost.
